page.layout: One page of text in a single column. At the top, the running head "De Duellis." with the page number at the right. Below it, the continued paragraph, then a rule, the centred chapter heading "CAP. II." with its italic title, and the opening paragraph with a large initial.

main_text.p: peditant, aut in gratiam reliquorum singulare subeunt certamen. Insuper, licet plures quandoque congrediantur, hunc tamen ordinem servare solent, ut bini concertent, quē-admodum apud antiquos aliquot paria dicebantur edita gladiatorum. Quicquid fit, non absurde dicetur esse duorum certamen, quia singuli cum singulis congrediuntur, hoc ipsum satis superque vocabulis, monomachias, singularis certaminis, ac duelli, indicantibus.
main_text.head: CAP. II. Utrum licita duella ludicra, glo-ria causâ suscepta?
main_text.p: DIuante Manuelem Commenium, Imperatorem Constantinopolitanum (ut id alibi perperam neget Pancirol-lus) in usu fuere, ludicri qui-

page.notes: The printed page number reads "I 3" in the scan; transcribed as 13. The running head and the page number are both at the top of the page. No marginal notes are printed. The bottom-right faint text is a digitiser mark and was left out. The word "dam" at the foot is the catchword completing "qui-dam". The large initial D is joined to "Iuante" as "DIuante".
